example: The country has been beset by economic woes for the past decade.
過去十年來這個國家一直受到經濟困難的困擾。
Unusually poor harvests have added to the country's woes.
罕見的差收成加劇了該國的災難。
Her face was lined and full of woe.
她滿臉皺紋，一副悲傷的表情。
He told me a real tale of woe about how he had lost both his job and his house in the same week.
他給我講了自己真實的不幸遭遇，是關於他如何在一週內既失業又失去房子。

NONE: › said when there will be trouble for someone, or someone will be punished, if they do a particular thing

example: This is the second time he's been sent home from school this month, so woe betide him if it happens again!
這是他本月內第二次從學校被趕回了家，要是再發生一次這樣的事，他就要倒楣了。

NONE: › said to express how unhappy you are

example: I'm cold and wet and I don't have enough money for the bus home. Oh woe is me!
我又冷又濕，連買張回家的公車票的錢也不夠。真是慘啊！
When he wants to go for a walk, the dog sits by the door with a woebegone expression.
當他想出去散散步時，那隻狗愁眉苦臉地坐在門邊。
There's no need to look so woebegone - we can get it fixed.
別那麼愁眉苦臉——我們能解決。

NONE: › very bad or (of something very bad or unpleasant) very large or extreme
極為悲哀的，極為悲傷的

example: The team's woeful record consists of six defeats in seven games.
這個隊非常糟糕的記錄是七場比賽中有六場敗北。
They displayed woeful ignorance of the safety rules.
他們對安全條例表現出極端的無知。
She was looking very woeful, with her eyes red and swollen.
她的眼睛又紅又腫，看起來十分悲傷。

NONE: › used to emphasize how bad a situation is
極其（用於強調情況的糟糕）

example: The safety precautions taken by large resort hotels are often woefully inadequate for the number of people who stay there.
那些旅遊勝地的大型飯店雖然採取了安全措施，但相對於遊客的人數來說，大多還不夠完善。
The school's textbooks are woefully out of date.
那間學校使用的課本太過時了。
